reviews.text: The staff was nice. They have a good vibe!
Brazilian clinic! Dr. Alessandra is wonderful ❤️
Very attentive

Excellent service, from the moment of booking until discharge, Dr. Alessandra treated my dog ​​with great care and competence.
I highly recommend it to everyone. 5⭐️

Update to my review:

I decided to remove my previous review due to Dr. Alessandra's willingness to resolve the error caused by her assistant.

She attended to me promptly, corrected Ralph's passport, and even provided me with a written statement as instructed by the DGAV (Directorate-General for Food and Veterinary).

I leave it to each person to go there and draw their own conclusions.

Perhaps things didn't go well for me because I wasn't attended to directly by the veterinarian.
I highly recommend it.

Doctor Nobre is very knowledgeable and thorough in her work. She spends the extra time needed to discuss the details involved with treatment. I have been to other Vets in Lisbon and highly recommend her over any other place.
The best veterinarian Leona and Pandora could have. Always available, very attentive, and with excellent service. Thank you for all the love and care for my girls! 🐾❤️ …
Service provided with availability, care, and a personal touch. Very satisfied.

My dog ​​Mel has been followed at this clinic for quite some time, and I only have praise for it. It was here that she had surgery to remove nodules, receives allergy shots, and always gets all her medication with care and affection that make all the difference.
Dr. Alessandra is attentive, dedicated, and extremely professional. In addition to impeccable in-person care, she also provides guidance via WhatsApp whenever needed, which conveys a lot of security and peace of mind.
I trust her completely and recommend her to everyone looking for a veterinarian who truly treats our furry friends like family.
We greatly appreciate your feedback and the trust you have placed in our team.
A spectacular clinic with excellent service and a professional doctor.

Excellent and professional, we had our Lara 🐶🐕 pass away with them, and although it was a very sad moment for our whole family, it was a highly humanized, calm and welcoming process. They deserve congratulations, thank you for everything. …
A team of excellent professionals. Very attentive and animal-loving.

A spectacular team. Dr. Alessandra is always ready to help and explain everything. My two dogs have already been operated on by her. I can only thank them. They are truly an excellent team. Thank you 🙏🏾 …
I love the care that Dr. Alessandra gives my pets. I only let her take care of them!
Thank you so much for your kindness and trust in our team! 💙 …

I recently took my cat Müjgan to Aniaid Clínica Veterinária and I was extremely satisfied with the experience. From the very beginning, the atmosphere was warm, friendly, and reassuring. The veterinarian was very knowledgeable and experienced, and we felt in safe hands throughout the entire visit. The staff were also incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful. A clinic where you can truly trust the people caring for your pets.
Dr. Alessandra was incredibly attentive to my Dodô and my Luck, both at the clinic and during home visits. I can only thank her for her care for my pets. Thank you!!

Excellent veterinary clinic, with great attention to detail and good service. I recommend it.
Caramela has no fear or apprehension about going, so it's approved by the pet itself.

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Drs. Tayana, Alanny, and Alessandra for the unparalleled care they gave to my beloved Snoopy (a 12-year-old and 10-month-old Basset Hound). I have no words to express my gratitude for the affection shown to him.
Thank you so much for your kindness and trust in our team! 💙 …

What wonderful service, best vet ever!
Thank you so much for your kindness and trust in our team! 💙 …
Very caring staff with pets.
The vet and the stuff are really kind and caring. We are happy to visit here each time.
Good service and excellent professionals.

Excellent, humane, and up-to-date service. The professionals are excellent and welcoming, even during difficult times. Allany's reception is always a calming presence during challenging moments. Dr. Alessandra is very helpful and supported us greatly during one of the most difficult times with our pet. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place that takes a holistic approach to pet care, stays updated on treatments, and clearly explains each step.
Thank you very much for your feedback.

I loved the service, I went to other veterinarians and didn't like them.
I recommend this one ☺️!

I would like to express my gratitude for the way I was received by all the staff at this clinic, especially Dr. Alessandra, who performed the routine check-up on my senior cat, Mia, with great care and professionalism. Throughout the consultation, she always provided information on the necessary procedures to determine the safest ways to obtain the best treatment for Mia to maintain a good quality of life and reach at least 20 years of age in my life and company 😀
Best veterinary care! Dr. Alessandra is an excellent professional, very focused on finding the root cause of the problem. She has great empathy and professionalism. The whole team is incredible!

I would like to express my gratitude to the clinic and especially to Dr. Alessandra, who treated my Benji with care, respect, and dignity until the very end. After having some not-so-good experiences with other professionals, we found Dr. Alessandra through some recommendations. Dr. Alessandra always guided and clarified everything about the process our Benji was going through, she was always available and very kind throughout this period. She was with us and gave us all the support until the end. We thank her from the bottom of our hearts for all the care and respect that was shown to us. If only all animals could be cared for by a vet who loves what they do.
Hugs, Amanda, João, and our ⭐️Benji

One of the best veterinarians I've found in recent times after some disappointments.
Dr. Alessandra is a caring, dedicated person who is concerned about reaching a diagnosis. She is very competent.
I really like the whole Aniaid team, everyone is attentive.
I was very lucky to find this clinic where I take my Tiquinho and where Smokey also goes.
I can only thank them.
I recommend it because it is a family-friendly and welcoming environment. 🙏

Excellent service, very professional and careful with the animals. Dr. Alexandra is a dedicated and super professional doctor! I really like it. I always come back with my two four-legged children. My mother has six and she only comes here too!
Thank you to the whole team.
I'm very happy with your feedback. Thank you so much.

Malick is an elderly cat who has started to feel some of the effects of age. We had a wonderful experience at Aniaid. All the staff are extremely attentive, and the calm way they handled Malick helped minimize his stress, as he's not a very easy cat to deal with strangers. Dr. Alessandra explained all the steps of the process very clearly and readily. The assistants were very helpful and have a great knack and patience for handling cats. We are very happy with the clinic's service, and Malick will continue to be cared for by these excellent professionals. Thank you! 😺

I love this clinic very much, our trusted doctor Alessandra is always very helpful and you can feel how much she loves animals, and how patient she is, even though my dachshund is not an easy client 😁 This clinic always gave us a lot of support, relevant information, and constantly stayed in touch in times when I was very worried about my dog’s state. Highly recommend!
Easy to book, affordable prices, and attentive and professional staff.

Very friendly and helpful team!
I always look for the best for my dog, I highly recommend them.

I took my kitten to the clinic, and we were very well received. Dr. Alessandra is an exemplary and loving professional. She was very careful and patient with my Rubia. I am very grateful for the care provided. I will bring my four-legged children back again.

Dr. Alessandra is an incredible and very kind professional, and she's always willing to help. She's the only one I trust to take care of my dog. The clinic is well-equipped and always has everything we need, and the other staff members are also excellent professionals.

Yesterday I went to this veterinarian for the first time, where Dr. Alessandra treated our Dutti! We liked her professionalism, her care for her, and her overall service. Plus, she has an agreement with our dog's health insurance. We recommend this veterinarian.

I would like to express my sincerest gratitude to the Veterinary Clinic for the excellent service provided. Dr. Alessandra is simply fantastic! She performed the neutering of my dog, Wally, with complete professionalism and care; the procedure was perfect. In addition, whenever an emergency arises, she is able to respond promptly and with dedication, conveying security and confidence.

I would also like to highlight the reception service, which is always welcoming and efficient. The friendliness and availability of the team make all the difference, making each visit more peaceful.

I recommend this clinic without hesitation, for the competence, affection, and care shown at every moment. Thank you very much to the entire team!
I'm very happy with your feedback. Thank you so much.

Excellent service, the veterinarians were super friendly and attentive. A fantastic experience!

They are some of the best people to take care of our four-legged friends.
The doctor and the assistants are incredibly caring and concerned about the animals.
I recommend this clinic 200%.
A very good, professional veterinarian who is kind to animals. I definitely recommend her; she's where I take my cats.
The best in Benfica. I highly recommend it.

I only have positive feedback regarding Dr. Alessandra Nobre's work. We were very pleased to meet her; she gave us very interesting tips, and there is no doubt that she is an excellent professional who loves what she does.
I couldn't ask for a better professional and a better person for my cat. I'm so happy to have found this place and these people.
I'm giving 5 stars because I can't give more, the service was top-notch, a super attentive doctor, a super friendly assistant, and they were all incredibly humane. …
We love Aniaid and Dr.Alessandra Nobre. She takes her time and provides us with great information about the care she provides. So happy to have found this office for our dog!
